profile.name: Tommy Reardon
profile.title: Robotics Engineer
profile.bio: I'm an engineer driven by a passion for bringing ideas to life — from early concept through to a finished, market-ready product. With a background in Robotics Engineering, I thrive in hands-on environments where I can design, build, and iterate on real physical systems.

experience.description: Designed and developed mechanical components using SolidWorks. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within spec.
highlights: Led design of XYZ assembly reducing weight by 15%

projects.title: Custom Bracket Assembly
projects.description: Designed a custom aluminum bracket assembly for an industrial conveyor system. Modeled in SolidWorks with full drawing package and BOM.

projects.title: 3D Printed Enclosure
projects.description: Designed and iterated an electronic enclosure for rapid prototyping. Multiple design revisions tested for fitment and thermal performance.
